subject: URGENT!!! Your Account Will Be BLOCKED In 24 Hours
body:
Dear Valued Costumer,

We noticed unusual activity on your account. Your account will be BLOCKED within 24 hours unless you verify your details.

Click below and enter your BVN, ATM card number and 4-digit PIN to keep your account active:

Verify My Account Now

Failure to comply will result in permanent closure.

GTBank Security Team

red_flags.description: A bank writing from a free @gmail.com address
Threat of account closure within 24 hours
Asks for your card PIN and BVN, which no bank ever requests
Spelling mistake: "Costumer"
Link goes to gtb-verify-account.xyz, not gtbank.com

explanation: Banks never ask for your PIN or BVN by email. Urgency, a Gmail sender and a strange link are the classic signs of a banking phish.

subject: CONGRATULATIONS!!! You Have Won ₦5,000,000
body:
Congratulations!

Your phone number was randomly selected as a WINNER in the MTN Mega Anniversary Promo. You have won ₦5,000,000 (Five Million Naira).

To claim your prize, pay a processing fee of ₦15,000 to the account below and send your receipt to our claims agent on WhatsApp.

Account: 0123456789 | Bank: Opay | Name: Promo Claims Office

Offer expires TODAY.

red_flags.description: You won a promo you never entered
You must pay a "processing fee" to receive a prize
Payment goes to a personal account, not MTN
Sent from a free Outlook address
"Expires TODAY" pressure

explanation: Real prizes never require you to pay to receive them. This is advance-fee fraud dressed up as a promo.

subject: Federal Government Youth Grant ₦250,000 Approved For You
body:
Good day,

You have been approved for the Federal Government Youth Empowerment Grant of ₦250,000.

To receive payment, reply to this email with:
- Full name
- NIN
- BVN
- Bank account number
- Date of birth

Payment will be made within 48 hours. Do not share this message.

Central Bank of Nigeria

red_flags.description: Government agency using a Yahoo address
Asks for NIN, BVN and bank details by email reply
You never applied for a grant
"Do not share this message" secrecy

explanation: Government bodies use .gov.ng addresses and never collect NIN or BVN over email. Free money plus requests for ID numbers means identity theft.

subject: You Won an iPhone 15 Pro Max – Pay Delivery Only!
body:
JUMIA

Hello Lucky Customer!!!

You are our 1,000,000th visitor and you have won a brand new iPhone 15 Pro Max!

Just pay ₦4,500 for delivery and your phone will arrive in 2 days.

CLAIM MY IPHONE

Only 3 phones left!

red_flags.description: "1,000,000th visitor" prize is a well-known scam line
Domain jumia-free-gifts.net is not jumia.com.ng
Pay a small fee to receive an expensive prize
Fake scarcity: "Only 3 phones left!"

explanation: A free expensive gift that only needs a small payment is bait. The real Jumia emails from jumia.com.ng.

subject: Your payment was declined – update now
body:
NETFLIX

Dear Costumer,

We was unable to process your last payment. Your Netflix membership will be cancel today.

Please update your card details to continue enjoying Netflix:

Update Payment

Netflix Team

red_flags.description: Misspelled domain: netflx-support.com (missing the "i")
Bad grammar: "We was unable", "will be cancel"
Cancellation today unless you act
Asks you to enter card details through a link

explanation: Typosquatted domains like "netflx" are cheap to register. If billing is really a problem, open the Netflix app directly.

subject: Work From Home – Earn $500 Daily, No Experience
body:
Hello,

Shell Nigeria is hiring online workers. No interview, no experience. Earn $500 per day from your phone!

To secure your slot, pay a registration fee of ₦10,000 and message our HR manager on WhatsApp: +234 801 234 5678.

Slots are limited. Act fast!

red_flags.description: Big multinational recruiting from a Gmail address
Unrealistic pay with no interview or experience
Registration fee to get a job
Moves you to WhatsApp, away from official channels

explanation: Legitimate employers never charge you to apply. Job scams target students and graduates with easy-money promises.

subject: Mailbox Full – You Will Stop Receiving Emails
body:
Your mailbox has exceeded its storage limit (99.8%).

You will stop receiving new messages and old messages will be DELETED.

Click below and log in with your email password to upgrade your storage for free:

Upgrade Storage

System Administrator

red_flags.description: Generic "Mail Administrator" from an unrelated domain
Threat that your emails will be deleted
Asks you to log in through a link to "upgrade"
No company name, logo or contact

explanation: Fake "mailbox full" notices are a classic way to steal email passwords. Your real email provider shows storage warnings inside the app.

subject: STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL: Inheritance Fund of $8.5 Million
body:
Dear Friend,

I am Barrister James Williams, personal lawyer to the late Mr. Robert Okafor who died in a plane crash with his family. He left $8,500,000 USD in a bank with no next of kin. Since you share the same surname, I want to present you as the beneficiary.

We will share the money 50/50. Kindly send your full name, phone number and a copy of your ID card to begin the transfer.

This transaction is 100% risk free.

Yours faithfully,
Barr. James Williams

red_flags.description: A stranger offering you millions
Asks you to pose as a fake next of kin
Requests ID card and personal details
"100% risk free" and "strictly confidential"

explanation: This is the classic 419 scam. Once you reply, "fees" and "taxes" follow until you stop paying.

subject: Your package is on hold – pay customs fee
body:
DHL Express

Dear customer,

Your package could not be delivered because customs duty of ₦3,500 has not been paid.

Pay now to avoid your package being returned to sender:

Pay Customs Fee

DHL Express Nigeria

red_flags.description: You were not expecting a package
Domain dhl-parcels-ng.com is not dhl.com
Shortened bit.ly link hides the destination
Small fee request designed not to feel risky

explanation: Fake delivery fees are one of the most common scams. Track parcels yourself on the courier's official site using your tracking number.

subject: Upgrade Your JAMB Score Before Admission List
body:
Attention Candidate,

We can officially upgrade your UTME score to 300+ before the admission list is released.

Pay ₦20,000 and send your registration number and phone number. 100% guaranteed.

Don't miss this chance!

red_flags.description: Offers something impossible: changing an exam score
JAMB using a Gmail address
Asks for payment and your registration number
"100% guaranteed" promise

explanation: Score upgrades do not exist. JAMB uses jamb.gov.ng, and offers like this exist only to take your money.

subject: Your order #JM-284719 has been confirmed
body:
JUMIA

Hi Ada,

Thanks for shopping with Jumia! We've received your order.

Order number: JM-284719
Item: Oraimo FreePods 4 (Black) x1
Total: ₦28,500 (paid with card ending 4417)
Estimated delivery: 3–5 business days

You can track your order anytime in the Jumia app under My Orders.

The Jumia Team
trust_signals: Sent from the official jumia.com.ng domain
Specific order number, item and total you can check
Only shows the last 4 digits of the card
Tells you to use the app, no link to log in
explanation: A normal receipt: it gives information and asks for nothing. If you placed this order, the details will match your account.

subject: Your Friday evening trip with Uber
body:
Uber

Thanks for riding, Ada.

Trip: Yaba → Lekki Phase 1
Driver: Emeka
Distance: 18.4 km | Time: 42 min
Total: ₦7,850

Rate your trip or get help with this ride in the Uber app.
trust_signals: Official uber.com sender
Trip details match a real ride
No request for payment or login
explanation: A standard ride receipt. It refers you to the app for anything else rather than a link.

subject: Welcome to Google Cybersecurity Certificate
body:
coursera

Hi Ada,

You're enrolled in the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate. Your first module, Foundations of Cybersecurity, is ready.

Start learning

Tip: learners who set a weekly goal are more likely to finish.

The Coursera Team
trust_signals: Sender subdomain belongs to coursera.org
Link goes to coursera.org
Expected after you enroll in a course
No request for payment or passwords
explanation: Companies often send from subdomains like m.mail.coursera.org. What matters is that the main domain is genuine and nothing sensitive is requested.

subject: Security alert: New sign-in on Windows
body:
Google

New sign-in to your account
ada.okafor@gmail.com

We noticed a new sign-in to your Google Account on a Windows device. If this was you, you don't need to do anything.

If not, we'll help you secure your account.

Check activity

You can also see security activity at myaccount.google.com/notifications
trust_signals: Sent from accounts.google.com
Link goes to myaccount.google.com
Says no action is needed if it was you
Gives a web address you can type yourself
explanation: Real security alerts tell you what happened and let you check it yourself. They do not threaten you or ask for your password in the email.

subject: Standup moved to 10:30 tomorrow
body:
Hi team,

Quick heads-up: tomorrow's standup is moving from 9:30 to 10:30 because of the client call. Same Google Meet link as always.

Thanks,
Tolu
trust_signals: From a colleague at your own company domain, brightpath.ng
Ordinary request with no pressure
No links, attachments or requests for information
explanation: A routine message from a known colleague on the company domain, asking for nothing.

subject: Booking confirmed – Lagos to Abuja, ref XQ7P2L
body:
Air Peace

Dear Ada Okafor,

Your booking is confirmed.

Booking reference: XQ7P2L
Flight: P4 7120 Lagos (LOS) → Abuja (ABV)
Date: 24 Oct, 07:15

Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure on our website or app.

Thank you for flying Air Peace.
trust_signals: Addresses you by full name
Booking reference and flight details you can verify
Expected after making a booking
Asks for nothing
explanation: A booking confirmation full of verifiable details and no requests is what legitimate transactional mail looks like.

subject: Your Spotify Premium receipt
body:
Spotify

Hi Ada,

Thanks for your payment. Here's your receipt.

Plan: Premium Individual
Amount: ₦1,300
Payment method: Mastercard ending 4417
Next billing date: 18 Nov

Manage your plan in your account page on spotify.com.
trust_signals: Official spotify.com sender
Matches a subscription you pay for
Only last 4 card digits shown
No link to enter details
explanation: A routine receipt that tells you to manage things on the real website yourself.

subject: Reminder: Course registration closes Friday
body:
University of Ilorin

Dear Student,

This is a reminder that first semester course registration closes on Friday at 11:59 PM.

Please complete your registration on the student portal through the university website. Students who miss the deadline will pay a late registration fee.

Registry Department
University of Ilorin
trust_signals: Official .edu.ng university domain
Points you to the official website, no direct link
Deadline is normal academic information, not a threat
Asks for no personal details
explanation: Deadlines alone are not a red flag. This email sends you to a portal you already know rather than to a link it controls.

subject: You appeared in 14 searches this week
body:
LinkedIn

Hi Ada,

You appeared in 14 searches this week. Recruiters from fintech and cybersecurity companies were among those who found you.

See who's searching

Unsubscribe · Help
trust_signals: Official linkedin.com sender
Link goes to linkedin.com
Normal engagement email with unsubscribe option
explanation: A typical engagement notification. The link goes to the real domain and nothing is demanded.

subject: GeNS Transaction Notification: Debit ₦12,000
body:
GTBank

Dear ADA OKAFOR,

A debit transaction occurred on your account.

Account: ****4521
Amount: ₦12,000.00
Description: POS Purchase – Shoprite Lekki
Balance: ₦184,320.55

If you did not authorise this transaction, please call our contact centre on the number on the back of your card.

GTBank will never ask for your PIN, password or token code.
trust_signals: Official gtbank.com domain
Masked account number
Tells you to call the number on your card, not a number in the email
Reminds you the bank will never ask for your PIN
explanation: Transaction alerts are informational. A real one never asks you to click and verify anything.

subject: CBN Directive: Update your BVN-linked details
body:
Access Bank

Dear Customer,

In line with the recent CBN directive on account verification, all customers are required to re-validate their BVN-linked details by 31 October.

Accounts not updated will be placed on Post-No-Debit restriction.

Update my details

Thank you for banking with us.
Access Bank Plc

red_flags.description: Domain accessbank-ng.com is a lookalike (real: accessbankplc.com)
Uses a real-sounding regulator directive to justify urgency
Threatens a Post-No-Debit restriction
Asks you to update bank details through a link

explanation: Scammers borrow real news (CBN directives) to sound official. Banks handle BVN updates in the app or at a branch, never through an email link.

subject: Your Microsoft 365 password expires today
body:
Microsoft

Hello ada.okafor@brightpath.ng,

Your Microsoft 365 password is set to expire today. To keep your current password and avoid losing access to Outlook and Teams, confirm below.

Keep Current Password

Microsoft 365 Admin Center

red_flags.description: Domain uses a zero instead of an "o": micros0ft-365.com
"Keep current password" is not a real Microsoft feature
Generic IT Helpdesk not from your company domain
Link leads to a fake login page

explanation: Credential phishing often fakes password-expiry notices. Look letter-by-letter at the domain: 0 vs o is easy to miss.

subject: Settlement of ₦1,240,500 placed on hold
body:
paystack

Hello,

Your pending settlement of ₦1,240,500.00 has been placed on hold due to incomplete business verification.

To release your funds, log in and upload your CAC documents and director's BVN within 48 hours:

Release Settlement

Paystack Compliance

red_flags.description: Domain paystack-merchants.com is not paystack.com
Large held payment creates pressure
48-hour deadline
Asks for login plus CAC documents and BVN through a link

explanation: Business owners are targeted with fake payment-processor alerts. Always go to the dashboard by typing paystack.com yourself.

subject: You have 3 new messages from recruiters
body:
LinkedIn

Hi Ada,

You have 3 unread messages from recruiters at Flutterwave, Interswitch and Andela.

View messages

This email was intended for Ada Okafor.

red_flags.description: Sender domain linkedin-mail.net is not linkedin.com
Link is linkedln.com (a lowercase L instead of an i)
Uses famous company names as bait for job seekers

explanation: "linkedln" vs "linkedin" is a classic lookalike. Recruiter messages are tempting, so this works well on job hunters.

subject: Delivery attempt failed – Waybill GIG84021973
body:
GIG Logistics

Dear Customer,

Our rider attempted delivery of your shipment (Waybill: GIG84021973) but no one was available.

To reschedule, pay a redelivery fee of ₦850. Unclaimed shipments are returned after 3 days.

Reschedule Delivery

GIG Logistics

red_flags.description: Lookalike domain giglogistics-delivery.com
Requests a card payment through an email link
Waybill number looks real but you can't confirm it
Return-to-sender deadline adds pressure

explanation: Fake tracking numbers make delivery scams look real. Check the waybill on the courier's official site, not through the email.

subject: Tunde shared "Q4 Salary Adjustments.xlsx" with you
body:
Google

Tunde Bakare shared a spreadsheet with you.

Q4 Salary Adjustments.xlsx
"Please review before Friday – confidential"

Open in Sheets

Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA

red_flags.description: Sender domain google-docs-share.com is not google.com
Link does not go to docs.google.com
Salary file is irresistible bait
Copied Google footer to look authentic

explanation: Real Google share notifications come from google.com and open on docs.google.com. Copying a real footer is easy, so it proves nothing.

subject: Your OPay wallet will be frozen – complete KYC
body:
OPay

Dear OPay User,

Due to new KYC regulations, your wallet will be frozen within 24 hours unless you complete Tier-3 verification.

Tap below and enter your phone number, NIN and wallet PIN to verify:

Complete KYC

OPay Customer Care

red_flags.description: Domain opay-wallet-verify.com is not OPay's
Asks for your wallet PIN
24-hour freeze threat
KYC is done inside the app, not via email links

explanation: Fintech KYC upgrades happen in the app. Any request for your PIN is a scam, no matter how official it looks.

subject: You are eligible for a meter refund of ₦12,400
body:
Ikeja Electric

Dear Customer,

Following the NERC review of estimated billing, you are eligible for a refund of ₦12,400 on your prepaid meter account.

To receive your refund, confirm your debit card details:

Claim Refund

Ikeja Electric Customer Care

red_flags.description: Lookalike domain ikejaelectric-ng.com
Refunds never need your card details
Uses a real regulator (NERC) to sound credible

explanation: "Refund" scams flip the usual trick: instead of a fee, they promise money and capture your card details.

subject: Batch C: Confirm your details to avoid exclusion
body:
NYSC

Dear Prospective Corps Member,

Your name appears on the Batch C senate list, but your profile is incomplete.

Log in and pay the ₦5,000 data verification fee to avoid exclusion from mobilisation:

Complete Profile

NYSC Directorate Headquarters

red_flags.description: NYSC uses nysc.gov.ng, not nysc-portal-update.com
Unofficial "verification fee"
Fear of exclusion from mobilisation

explanation: Graduates are targeted around mobilisation dates. Official government sites end in .gov.ng.

subject: Claim your 20GB loyalty data bonus
body:
MTN

Y'ello Ada,

As a loyal customer you qualify for a free 20GB data bonus.

Claim it before midnight by signing in with your MyMTN details:

Claim 20GB

MTN Nigeria

red_flags.description: Domain mtn-ng-rewards.com is not MTN's
Free reward with a midnight deadline
Asks you to sign in through the link
Uses MTN's real catchphrase to feel authentic

explanation: Familiar slogans are easy to copy. Rewards are claimed in the official app or by USSD, not through email sign-ins.

subject: Critical security alert
body:
Google

Sign-in attempt was blocked
ada.okafor@gmail.com

Someone just used your password to try to sign in to your account from an unknown app. Google blocked them, but you should check what happened.

Check activity

You received this email to let you know about important changes to your Google Account and services.
trust_signals: Sent from accounts.google.com
Link goes to myaccount.google.com
Tells you the attempt was already blocked
Does not ask for your password in the email
explanation: Scary is not the same as fake. This real alert sends you to Google's own domain. If you are unsure, go to myaccount.google.com yourself.

subject: Microsoft account password change
body:
Microsoft

Microsoft account

Password change

The password for the Microsoft account ad*****@outlook.com was changed.

If this was you, then you can safely ignore this email.

If you didn't change your password, your account might have been compromised. Go to account.microsoft.com to reset your password.

Thanks,
The Microsoft account team
trust_signals: accountprotection.microsoft.com is Microsoft's real security domain
Masks your email address
No link to click, tells you where to go yourself
explanation: Long, odd-looking addresses can still be real. The sender ends in microsoft.com, and the email asks for nothing.

subject: Settlement of ₦386,200 sent to your bank
body:
paystack

Hi BrightPath Technologies,

We've sent a settlement to your bank account.

Amount: ₦386,200.00
Bank: Zenith Bank ****8890
Transactions: 47

View the full breakdown on your Paystack Dashboard.

Paystack
trust_signals: Official paystack.com domain
Informs you of money sent, asks nothing
Masked bank account number
explanation: Compare with the fake "settlement on hold" email: the real one informs, the fake one demands.

subject: [GitHub] A new SSH authentication public key was added to your account
body:
GitHub

The following SSH key was added to your account:

ada-laptop-2026
SHA256:9xJv3kQ8uYb...

If you believe this key was added in error, you can remove the key and disable access at the following location:

https://github.com/settings/keys

To see this and other security events for your account, visit github.com/settings/security-log
trust_signals: Official github.com domain
Matches an action you took (adding a key)
Points to settings pages on github.com
explanation: Security notifications that confirm actions you just took are expected. GitHub tells you where to check without asking for credentials.

subject: Your DStv Compact subscription is due in 3 days
body:
DStv

Dear Ada,

Your DStv Compact subscription for smartcard ending 7712 is due on 19 October.

You can pay through the MyDStv app, your bank app, or by USSD. Ignore this message if you have already paid.

DStv Customer Care
trust_signals: Official dstv.com domain
Masked smartcard number
Offers several official payment channels, no link
"Ignore if already paid": no pressure
explanation: A reminder that lets you pay through channels you already use is normal billing communication.

subject: Your order KNG-55210 has been shipped
body:
Konga

Hi Ada,

Good news! Your order KNG-55210 has shipped.

Item: HP 15s Laptop Bag
Courier: Konga Express

Track my order

Payment was already completed. No further action is needed.
trust_signals: Official konga.com domain
Tracking link goes to konga.com
Clearly states no payment is needed
explanation: A real shipping notice with a link to the store's own domain. Nothing extra to pay.

subject: HMO plan renewal – choose your plan by 25 Oct
body:
Hi everyone,

Our HMO renewal is coming up. Please choose your plan for next year on the HR page of the staff intranet before 25 October. If you don't choose, you'll stay on your current plan.

Questions? Drop by the People Team desk on the 3rd floor or message us on Slack.

People Team
trust_signals: Sent from your own company domain, brightpath.ng
Points to the intranet you already use
Default option if you do nothing, so no threat
Offers in-person and Slack contact
explanation: Internal HR mail with a calm deadline and familiar channels is normal.

subject: Invitation: Sprint Review @ Thu 23 Oct 2pm – 3pm (WAT)
body:
Google

Kemi Adebayo has invited you to an event.

Sprint Review
Thursday 23 October · 2:00 – 3:00pm (West Africa Time)
Join with Google Meet: meet.google.com/xqa-pmtr-gkn

Guests: kemi.adebayo@brightpath.ng, ada.okafor@brightpath.ng, tolu.adeyemi@brightpath.ng

Reply in Google Calendar
trust_signals: Sent from google.com's calendar service
Organiser and guests are on your company domain
Links go to calendar.google.com and meet.google.com
explanation: A meeting invite from a colleague via Google's real calendar service. All links stay on google.com.

subject: Transfer successful: ₦45,000 to Chidi Nwosu
body:
Moniepoint

Hi Ada,

Your transfer was successful.

Amount: ₦45,000.00
Recipient: CHIDI NWOSU – Access Bank
Reference: MNP2610161309

If you did not make this transfer, call us immediately using the number in the Moniepoint app.
trust_signals: Official moniepoint.com domain
Details of a transfer you made
Directs you to the in-app number
explanation: Transaction confirmations inform you and point to contact details you already trust.

subject: Fraud alert: Staff will never ask for your OTP
body:
Access Bank

Dear Valued Customer,

Fraudsters are calling customers and pretending to be bank staff. Please remember:

  • We will NEVER ask for your PIN, OTP, password or BVN.
  • We will NEVER send you a link to update your account.
  • If in doubt, call 01-2712005 or visit any branch.

Stay safe,
Access Bank Plc
trust_signals: Official accessbankplc.com domain
Gives security advice and asks for nothing
No links at all
explanation: Security awareness messages are normal. Notice how this one contradicts what the fake BVN email asked you to do.

subject: Quick favour
body:
Ada,

Are you at your desk? I'm in back-to-back board meetings and can't take calls.

I need you to process an urgent payment of ₦4,850,000 to a new vendor for the Abuja project before 2pm. Account details below. Keep this between us for now, I'll explain later.

Acct: 2038847712 – Zenith Bank – Novatek Integrated Services

Sent from my iPhone
Adebayo

red_flags.description: Domain is brightpath-ng.com, but your company is brightpath.ng
Urgent payment to a new, unverified vendor
Secrecy: "Keep this between us"
Blocks verification: "can't take calls"
Bypasses normal approval process

explanation: This is CEO fraud (Business Email Compromise). No links, no malware, just pressure from "the boss". Always verify payment requests on a separate channel.

subject: RE: Invoice ZS-2291 – updated bank details
body:
Good morning Ada,

Following our audit, our company has changed banks. Kindly make payment for invoice ZS-2291 (₦2,140,000) into our new account below and update your records.

Acct: 1190027385 – Moniepoint MFB – Zentrix Supplies Ltd

Please confirm once payment is done. Thank you for your continued partnership.

Chiamaka Eze
Accounts, Zentrix Supplies

red_flags.description: Reply-To goes to a different domain: zentrix-supplies.co
Request to change a supplier's bank details by email
Invoice number is real-looking because the attacker may have read past emails
Payment to a new account at a different bank

explanation: Vendor email compromise: the supplier's real mailbox may be hacked, so the sender looks right. Always confirm bank-detail changes by phone using a number you already have.

subject: Action required: Unusual sign-in to brightpath.ng admin console
body:
Google

Google Workspace

We detected a suspicious sign-in to the admin console for brightpath.ng from Moscow, Russia.

If this wasn't you, review the activity immediately:

https://admin.google.com/ac/security

The Google Workspace Team

red_flags.description: The link text shows admin.google.com, but the real link goes to admin.google.com.security-review.io
Sender domain google-workspace-admin.com is not google.com
Foreign-location scare to rush you

explanation: The visible link text can say anything. Hover over (or long-press) links to see where they really go. Here the real domain is security-review.io.

subject: Please DocuSign: Employment Contract Amendment 2026
body:
DocuSign

BrightPath HR sent you a document to review and sign.

Employment Contract Amendment 2026.pdf

Please review and sign by end of day.

REVIEW DOCUMENT

Do Not Share This Email: This email contains a secure link to DocuSign.

red_flags.description: Real domain is esign-review.com. "docusign.net" is just a subdomain prefix
Unexpected contract change with same-day deadline
HR did not mention this through normal channels

explanation: Read domains from the right: in docusign.net.esign-review.com, the part that matters is esign-review.com. Attackers put trusted names on the left.

subject: Remittance advice – payment of ₦3,600,000
body:
Hello,

Please find attached the remittance advice for the payment made to your company today.

Kindly open the attachment and sign in with your company email to view the secure document.

Regards,
Kunle Afolabi
Finance

red_flags.description: Attachment is an .html file disguised with a .pdf in its name
A PDF should never ask you to sign in with your email
Unexpected payment notice from an unfamiliar contact

explanation: HTML attachments open a fake login page in your browser. Watch for double extensions like .pdf.html.

subject: MFA migration tonight – reply with your code
body:
Hi Ada,

We're migrating all staff accounts to the new MFA system tonight. In the next few minutes you'll receive a 6-digit verification code by SMS.

Please reply to this email with the code so we can link your device. If we don't receive it by 7pm your account will be locked until Monday.

Thanks,
IT Service Desk

red_flags.description: Asks you to share a one-time code. IT never needs your code
Threat of lockout until Monday
Sender is your real company domain, so the account may be compromised or spoofed
A real migration would be announced in advance

explanation: The sender address is correct, but the request is the red flag. Anyone asking for your MFA code is trying to log in as you.

subject: [GitHub] Critical vulnerability detected in brightpath/payments-api
body:
GitHub

A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-31337) was detected in your repository brightpath/payments-api.

To run an automated fix, authorize the GitHub Security Scanner app:

Authorize Security Scanner

Requested permissions: read and write access to code, admin access to organization.

GitHub Security Lab

red_flags.description: Sender domain github-advisories.com is not github.com
Link is on the real github.com, but it authorises an unknown third-party app
Requests write access to code and admin access to the organization
